en: Vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a busy public square or main street during a celebration or parade. Many people in early 20th‑century clothing gather along the sidewalks and in the open square. There are decorated arches covered with greenery and flags spanning the street, and period automobiles are visible on the left. Multi‑story European‑style buildings with shops line the right side, while a larger building and trees stand at the back of the square. Cyrillic signage is visible on the decorations and buildings.
